judgment.notes: N001 applies to E⊆Eucl(n) with q>D≥0, and to F⊆Eucl(n+1) with exponents a>1 or q+1>0. N002 supplies finiteness and nonnegativity of D. All ball, power, series and infimum facts have their actual local conditions verified in BG001–BG007. There are no E/M applications.

For n=0 the interval partitions have mesh and a-cost tending to zero. For n≥1 the singleton replacements preserve coverage with the stated summable budget; the ceiling partition gives at most 2/r_i product pieces, each of diameter at most sqrt(2)r_i. Their (q+1)-cost is bounded by the stated constant times epsilon. Sending the cost tolerance to zero at each fixed scale, then taking the supremum over scales, proves H^{q+1}(F)=0. The final q↓D order argument proves exactly N003.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
